```yaml
name: ADR Agent Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: [main, master]

jobs:
  adr-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          format: json
          filter: '.*'

      - name: Export changed files
        run: echo "CHANGED_FILES=${{ steps.changed.outputs.all }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup agent environment
        uses: github/gh-aw/actions/setup@32b3a711a9ee97d38e3989c90af0385aff0066a7
        with:
          destination: /tmp/agent
          safe-output-custom-tokens: true

      - name: Run ADR Generator Agent
        uses: anomalyco/opencode/github@latest
        with:
          model: gpt-4o-mini
          agent: .github/agents/adr-generator.agent.md
          share: false
          prompt: ""
          use_github_token: true
          mentions: ""
          variant: ""
          oidc_base_url: ""

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ADR review completed by Copilot Coding Agent. Please review any new ADRs added to `docs/adr/`.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          reactions: "eyes"
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-tag: "adr-review"
          mode: "replace"
          create-if-not-exists: true
```
